note: Reviewed evidence per script function (docs/tools/story-capture.md). The census text (questlines/systems/census.py) is hand-written and was stale in places; a function listed here counts as synced only while EVERY capture and apply token below is still present in the source (file + regex), and, when `effect` names Effect / WorldEffect types, while those types are captured and applied by the scanner of live_status.py. Remove a hook and the function drops back to partial. `status: local` classifies a function as per-machine presentation; the reason is in `why`.

groups.capture: moveCmd (marker + offsets, else final position + cell) and h_SetPos
groups.apply: RemoteApplier::applyMove: marker, same-cell SetPos per axis, cross-cell via an anchor of the destination cell, parked until that cell loads (MoveQueue)
groups.note: party-wide story warps are expanded from the captured MoveRef of the player by the rules engine (PartyWarp), not by the capture

groups.apply: console KillActor / ResurrectActor 0 on the actor; the applier falls back to the process-wide console executor, so coop_module's own applier works too

groups.why: SwapTexture in the census is the C-Finder weapon screen (SwapTexture player "##Screen:0" ...), a texture on the weapon of whoever holds it, driven by that weapon's own script on that player's machine (object scripts run on every machine). The one world-shared use, the ending slideshow, has its own channel (L11 plugin/hooks_ui/slideshow.h).
